issue.title: Codex native model list falls back from 500K to stale 272K after an upstream timeout
issue.body:
With native ChatGPT sign-in and **Long conversations → Full window**, Codex can receive the official 500,000-token window for `gpt-6.1-sol`, then revert to stale 272,000 after an upstream model-list timeout.

Observed with Codex client `0.162.0` on macOS arm64: direct official requests returned 500,000; one magpie request returned 272,000 after 3.03 seconds. The provider cache held the previous day's value. The conversation's usable window fell from 475,000 to 258,400, followed by compaction at approximately 277K input tokens. No explicit window or compaction override was configured.

### Reproduction and cause

Reproduced on upstream `2810a7154dd9f6cfb9cc376fa2c50d5e4bc2236d`:

1. Seed the provider model cache with 272,000.
2. Successfully receive an official 500,000-token list and let Codex cache it.
3. Time out the next upstream model-list request.

After its three-second deadline, `codexModels` uses Codex's rendered cache, then `CodexNativeWindow(true)` restores the older provider window.

### Proposed fix

Save successful, nonempty raw backend lists before applying overrides, filters or multi-agent policy. On failure, reuse the matching snapshot and apply current settings again. Snapshots are atomic and separated by upstream, query/client version, user and workspace; token rotation preserves user identity. Credentials and identity fields are not saved.

Explicit overrides, removing overrides, real upstream reductions and authentication errors retain their intended behavior. Legacy fallback remains available before a snapshot exists. No periodic refresh or longer timeout is added.

Implementation: https://github.com/NorethSea/magpie/commit/cf10a24d73915ee57f07e8a1a635e5812187bc11

### Validation

- Final regression tests fail on the unmodified base and pass with the fix.
- Full Go suite passed: `go test -tags nogui -p 4 -timeout 20m ./...`.
- New regressions passed 20 runs under `-race`.
- Formatting and macOS/Linux/Windows vet/build checks passed.
- An isolated built macOS gateway received a real official 500K list, then retained 500K after restart with upstream blocked.

Tests used temporary homes and pinned caches. The final full run used a direct Node binary and allowed macOS system discovery after the initial sandbox/Volta restrictions were identified. Linux/Windows runtime and post-install large-context compaction were not tested. The live installation was not replaced. Credentials, account identifiers and personal paths are omitted.

Related: #1895 (default policy; this report concerns fallback while Full window is already enabled).

comments.body:
Fixed in my fork: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/5040ec8a6b2d834c6c08fe44418e19343ca780ad (branch `fix/1955-codex-native-model-list-falls`)

**Cause.** When the backend gave no list within `codexModelsWait`, `codexModels` (`internal/gateway/codex_backend.go`) built the answer from Codex's own cache (correct, 500000) and then `codexMerged` applied `provider.CodexNativeWindow(true)`, whose restore step reads `catalog.Live("codex")` (`internal/provider/codex_models.go`) — the provider's own saved list, older, still 272000. Nothing of the backend's last answer was kept, so the regression lasted for the whole outage and after every restart.

**Change.** The backend's last raw list is now kept on disk, one hash-named file per sign-in (upstream + account + client-version query, no token or account readable), written aside and renamed on every successful ask. `codexModels` serves it when the backend gives nothing — across restarts — as the backend's own list, so only the current settings apply and the provider's saved windows are not restored onto it. With no kept list yet the old fallback stands unchanged, and 401/403 still pass through. `docs/subsystems/gateway-routing.md` documents the order.

**Test.** `TestCodexModelListKeepsBackendsWindowOnTimeout` fails on the unmodified file (`gpt-6.1-sol context_window 272000 (true) after the timeout, want the backend's 500000, not the provider's 272000`) and passes in 0.20 s with it. `gofmt`, `go build ./...`, `go vet ./internal/gateway/` plus `GOOS=windows` and `GOOS=linux -tags nogui` vet, the 18 model-list/cached-list tests and `-race -count=5` on them are clean.

**Pre-existing, not from this change.** In a full gateway run that did finish, `TestServeWSLListensBesideLoopback` and `FuzzMarshalRaw/seed#7` fail identically on clean `upstream/main`. One full `internal/gateway` run on this machine did not complete past 20 minutes.

**Not covered.** No run against a real ChatGPT sign-in or a macOS/Windows runtime (the reporter already did that). A window override removed while the backend is unreachable still stays in Codex's cache until the backend answers again — the pre-existing fallback, pinned by `TestCodexCachedListUnderCodexHomeKeepsItsMax`, was deliberately left alone.

issue.title: [Feature/Bug] 自定义 Responses 供应商支持 Codex 原生模型目录，保留上游工作窗口与最大窗口

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 问题概述

自定义 OpenAI Responses 供应商可能同时提供两种模型目录：

1. 普通 OpenAI 风格目录：`{"data":[{"id":"example-model", ...}]}`
2. Codex 原生目录：`{"models":[{"slug":"example-model","context_window":...,"max_context_window":...}]}`

目前 Magpie 的 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅接入已有专门读取原生目录的逻辑，但自定义供应商的 Models URL 仍走通用解析，无法直接使用同样的目录元数据。这会让第三方 Responses 网关经过 Magpie 后丢失正确的工作窗口与最大窗口，改用 models.dev 补全值及 Magpie 默认工作窗口。

这不是某个网关特有的问题：任何提供 Codex 原生模型目录、但以“地址 + API Key”作为自定义供应商接入的中继，都可能遇到。

## 已核查环境与匿名化结果

- Magpie：`v0.1.1310`。
- 接入方式：自定义供应商，协议选择 **OpenAI Responses**。
- Codex 从 Magpie 的 `/v1/codex/models` 读取目录。
- 未设置该供应商/模型的上下文或压缩覆盖，也未开启全局 Full window。
- 以下模型 ID、供应商 ID 均为占位符；数值来自实际 GET 核查。不附部署地址、凭据或原始日志。

直连上游的 Codex 原生目录，相关字段为：

```json
{
  "models": [
    {
      "slug": "example-model",
      "context_window": 500000,
      "max_context_window": 872000
    }
  ]
}
```

同一模型经过 Magpie 后，Codex 目录中的相关字段变为：

```json
{
  "models": [
    {
      "slug": "relay/example-model",
      "context_window": 272000,
      "max_context_window": 922000
    }
  ]
}
```

以上仅为字段节选，不是完整模型条目。在这次核查的 Codex 客户端中，有效窗口按 95% 计算，因此表现为原来的 475000 变成 258400。

Magpie 普通 `/v1/models` 返回的该模型窗口为 922000、最大输出为 128000。将自定义供应商的 Catalog / models.dev ID 改成 `openai` 后，原生工作窗口与最大窗口仍未恢复；Catalog 补全来源不等于目录协议选择。

## 复现方式

1. 准备一个支持 Responses、使用 API Key 鉴权的第三方网关。其普通模型列表仅列出 ID；另一个模型目录请求返回 Codex 原生格式及准确的 `context_window`、`max_context_window`。例如，部分网关通过 `/v1/models?client_version=<supported-version>` 返回原生目录。
2. 在 Magpie 添加自定义供应商，选择 OpenAI Responses，使用普通模型列表发现模型。
3. 比较直连上游原生目录与 Magpie `/v1/codex/models` 的窗口字段。
4. 尝试将自定义供应商的 Models URL 直接指向原生目录。当前通用解析器使用 `id` / `name`，不识别以 `slug` 为 ID 的原生条目，因此仅修改 URL 并不能解决。

第 4 点依据下述版本的解析代码判断；未对所有第三方网关逐一实测。

## 源码核查

基于 `v0.1.1310`：

- `internal/provider/models.go`：自定义 `ModelsURL` 在 `fetchOne` 中走 `catalog.FetchURL`。
- `internal/catalog/live.go`：`fetchPage` 虽接受 `data` / `models` 数组，但模型 ID 从 `id` / `name` 获取，没有按 Codex 的 `slug`、`context_window`、`max_context_window` 解析。
- `internal/provider/codex_models.go`：已有 `codexModels` / `parseCodexModels` 读取上述原生字段，但用于订阅账号路径。
- `internal/settings/settings.go`、`internal/provider/compact.go`、`internal/codexcat/codexcat.go`：目录解析后仍有工作窗口策略，因此不能只解析两个字段，却在输出时再次无条件套用默认 272000。

## 期望与建议

希望自定义 Responses 供应商也能使用 Codex 原生目录，例如增加可选的“模型目录格式：OpenAI / Codex”，或以其他明确、兼容的方式识别原生目录。具体 UI 形式由维护者决定。

关键是端到端保留语义，而不是硬编码某个模型的窗口：

- 正确读取 `slug`，并保留上游的工作窗口与最大窗口，不让缺省的目录补全值替代已知的上游元数据。
- 在没有用户显式覆盖时，允许采用上游原生工作窗口；用户明确设置的 Context window / Compact at 仍应按清楚定义的优先级生效。
- 不把最大窗口误当默认工作窗口，也不把 Codex 的有效窗口比例提前乘到 Magpie 返回的 `context_window` 上。
- 在宿主支持的范围内保留推理等级、输入模态、服务档位等同一目录中的能力信息。
- 不改变现有普通 OpenAI 模型列表、订阅登录和路由行为；沿用供应商鉴权，不要求用户把订阅凭据交给 Magpie。
- 建议回归测试同时覆盖：普通目录、原生目录、字段缺失回退、上游元数据刷新、显式覆盖优先级，以及最终 `/v1/codex/models` 的工作窗口/最大窗口。

目前可以手工为模型设置 Context window 和 Compact at 作为绕过方式，但逐模型维护容易随上游变化而失效，不等于自动读取原生目录。

## 与已有议题的区别

与 #1895 的默认工作窗口策略相关，但本议题重点是**自定义 API Key 供应商的 Codex 原生目录输入与元数据传递**，不是统一提高全局阈值。

也不同于 #1955 的订阅原生目录超时/旧缓存回退，以及 #674 的订阅模型手工窗口覆盖。

issue.title: Codex /backend-api/codex/models times out (>5 s) → Codex falls back to default model metadata → group models lose tool_search and ~1,000 connector tools are inlined (~500K tokens/request)

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Environment
- magpie 0.1.1566 (macOS, Codex takeover via `openai_base_url = http://127.0.0.1:3425/backend-api/codex`)
- Codex CLI / ChatGPT.app app-server 0.164.0-alpha.11.1, model `group/<routing-group>`
- ChatGPT account with many Apps connectors (codex_apps ≈ 1,075 tools)
- Many concurrent `codex app-server` processes (~20)

## What happens
1. A freshly started Codex process finds models_cache.json older than its 300 s TTL and asks magpie's `/backend-api/codex/models`.
2. The request exceeds Codex's 5 s MODELS_REFRESH_TIMEOUT. Codex logs `failed to refresh available models: request timed out` (1,906 times in one day here) and keeps its bundled list.
3. The group slug isn't in the bundled list: `Unknown model group/<name> is used. This will use fallback model metadata.` The fallback has `supports_search_tool: false`.
4. Codex then exposes MCP/Apps tools Direct instead of Deferred (codex-rs core/src/mcp_tool_exposure.rs). The request carries no `tool_search`, and ~1,075 codex_apps functions are inlined.
5. magpie's `roomy()` correctly drops members whose windows are too small (e.g. a 500K Grok seat), so only 1M-window members are left to take the request. Every turn costs ~470–550K input tokens, which goes past Codex's own 272K auto-compact window, and compaction can't shrink tools.

## Evidence
- Routing records (prompt parts as sent by Codex): bad turns show `tools: codex_apps n=1075 ≈ 400K tokens`, with no tool_search. Good turns show `tool_search ≈ 8K`.
- Reproduction with a fake upstream, same Codex binary and prompt "reply ok":
  - Without model metadata: request 2,075,608 bytes, 1,199 functions, no tool_search.
  - With `-c model_catalog_json=<catalog with the group entry, supports_search_tool=true>`: request 116,404 bytes, 16 functions, tool_search present.
- Timeline: the WARN in the first bad session comes 11 s after process start. Other processes logged refresh timeouts in the same second.

## Expected
`/backend-api/codex/models` always answers within Codex's 5 s budget and always includes the routing groups, so Codex never uses fallback metadata for a magpie group.

## Suggested fix (PR sketch)
- `internal/gateway/codex_backend.go` `codexModels`: serve the magpie part of the list before calling the backend. Budget the whole handler (backend wait + `provider.Hold()` build) under ~3.5 s, not just `codexModelsWait = 3s` for the upstream call. When the backend is slow, answer at once from `codexcat.CacheEntries()` plus `provider.CodexListed()`, and refresh the backend list in the background (single-flight, shared by concurrent callers, since ~20 app-servers poll at once).
- Memoize the built magpie entries (groups/windows) between provider changes, so concurrent `/models` calls don't each rebuild them.
- Optionally (Codex takeover only): write and point Codex at a `model_catalog_json` that holds magpie's groups as a floor, or document that as the workaround.
- Test: a slow fake backend (>5 s) must still return the group entries in <5 s with `supports_search_tool` preserved.

## Related
#1955, #1882, #1289

issue.title: [Bug] Codex catalog: context_window gets the 272000 template value instead of the model's real context

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## Summary

When magpie wires **Codex**, the generated catalog (`~/.codex/magpie-desktop-models.json`) gives every routed (non-native) model `context_window: 272000` while putting the model's real context in `max_context_window`. Codex reads `context_window`, so a 1M-context model is shown and used as 272K.

`272000` is exactly **GPT-5.6-Luna's** context — the OpenAI template default is being used instead of the vendor's real number that magpie already knows (it writes that number into `max_context_window`).

## Environment

- magpie **0.1.1734**, Windows 11 x64
- Agent: **Codex** (`model_catalog_json = "magpie-desktop-models.json"` in `~/.codex/config.toml`)
- Provider: **OpenCode Go** (`opencode.ai`), model `opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash`, via `openai_base_url = http://127.0.0.1:3425/backend-api/codex`
- Observed 2026-10-28

## What happens

Codex shows ~272K (258K usable after output reserve) for a model that actually has 1M.

## Expected

Codex should show/use **1,000,000** for `opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash`.

## Evidence

### 1. magpie's own gateway reports the correct number

`GET http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/models`:

```json
{"id":"opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash","context_length":1000000,"context_window":1000000,"max_input":1000000}
{"id":"opencode-go/deepseek-v4-pro","context_length":1000000,"context_window":1000000,"max_input":1000000}
```

models.dev, which magpie also uses, agrees — `[opencode-go] deepseek-v4.1-flash: limit={"context":1000000,"output":384000}`.

### 2. The generated Codex catalog disagrees

From `~/.codex/magpie-desktop-models.json` (32 models, generated by magpie):

```json
{
  "slug": "opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash",
  "context_window": 272000,        // what Codex reads
  "max_context_window": 1000000    // the real value, unused by Codex
}
```

### 3. The pattern is systematic — models *without* `max_context_window` get the right value

| slug | context_window | max_context_window | correct? |
|---|---|---|---|
| opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash | **272000** | 1000000 | no |
| opencode-go/deepseek-v4-pro | **272000** | 1000000 | no |
| opencode-go/glm-5.2 | **272000** | 1000000 | no |
| opencode-go/glm-5.3 | **272000** | 1000000 | no |
| opencode-go/glm-5.3-flash | **272000** | 1000000 | no |
| opencode-go/grok-4.6 | **272000** | 500000 | no |
| opencode-go/grok-4.7 | **272000** | 500000 | no |
| opencode-go/kimi-k3 | **272000** | 1048576 | no |
| opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-pro | **272000** | 1048576 | no |
| opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contributor | **272000** | 1048576 | no |
| gpt-6-luna / gpt-5.6-terra / gpt-5.6-luna | **272000** | 872000 | no |
| **opencode-go/glm-5.1** | **200000** | (none) | yes |
| **opencode-go/kimi-k2.6** | **262144** | (none) | yes |
| **opencode-go/kimi-k2.7-code** | **262144** | (none) | yes |
| **opencode-go/hy3** | **192000** | (none) | yes |
| **opencode-go/minimax-m2.5** | **204800** | (none) | yes |

**The rule is exact**: if `max_context_window` is emitted, `context_window` loses its real value and becomes 272000; if it is not emitted, `context_window` keeps the correct vendor value.

## Impact

- The agent's context accounting (compaction thresholds, "context left", `/context`) is computed from `context_window`. A 1M model is treated as 272K: Codex compacts far earlier than needed, and the difference is invisible in the UI.
- Users cannot fix it from magpie: `magpie codex` has no context field (`model, effort, subagent, subagent_model, subagent_effort, memories, login`), and there is no per-model context override in the provider editor.
- The only workaround is editing `magpie-desktop-models.json`, which magpie regenerates on the next apply/sync.

## Suggested fix

When building the Codex catalog entry, take `context_window` from the model's real context (the same value already written to `max_context_window` / the vendor `/v1/models` `context_length`) rather than from the OpenAI template default. `max_context_window` can stay as the ceiling; `context_window` should be the effective window.

Optionally a per-model context override in the provider editor, so a regeneration does not fight a user's pin.

## Notes

- Filed from a real setup; no crafted case. Verified by reading magpie's own `/v1/models`, models.dev, and the generated catalog on the same machine.
- The same 272000 also appears for the native `gpt-6-luna`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, `gpt-5.6-luna`, `gpt-reserve`, `codex-auto-review` rows (with `max_context_window` 872000). If the template value is intentional for those, the issue is only that it is also applied to routed (non-OpenAI) models with a different real context.

issue.title: [Bug] Codex catalog: context_window gets the 272000 template value instead of the model's real context

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Summary

When magpie wires Codex, the generated catalog (magpie-desktop-models.json) gives every non-native model context_window: 272000 while putting the model's real context in max_context_window. Codex reads context_window, so a 1M-context model is shown and used as 272K.

272000 is exactly the context of GPT-5.6-Luna — i.e. the OpenAI template value is being used as the default instead of the vendor's real number that magpie already knows (it writes that number into max_context_window).

Environment

  • magpie 0.1.1734, Windows 11 x64

  • Agent: Codex (ChatGPT desktop app, model_catalog_json = "magpie-desktop-models.json" in ~/.codex/config.toml)

  • Provider: OpenCode Go (opencode.ai), model opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash, routed through openai_base_url = http://127.0.0.1:3425/backend-api/codex

  • Observed 2026-10-28

What happens

Codex shows the model's context window as ~272K (with output reserved, ~258K usable) instead of the 1M the model actually has.

Expected

Codex should show/use 1,000,000 for opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash.

Evidence

1. magpie's own gateway reports the correct number

GET http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/models:

 {"id":"opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash","context_length":1000000,"context_window":1000000,"max_input":1000000}
 {"id":"opencode-go/deepseek-v4-pro","context_length":1000000,"context_window":1000000,"max_input":1000000}

models.dev, which magpie also uses, agrees — [opencode-go] deepseek-v4.1-flash: limit={"context":1000000,"output":384000}.

2. The generated Codex catalog disagrees

From ~/.codex/magpie-desktop-models.json (generated by magpie, 32 models):

 {
   "slug": "opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash",
   "context_window": 272000,        // <- what Codex reads
   "max_context_window": 1000000    // <- the real value, but Codex does not use it
 }

3. The pattern is systematic — models without max_context_window get the right value

The rule is exact: if max_context_window is emitted, context_window loses its real value and becomes 272000; if it is not emitted, context_window keeps the correct vendor value.

Why 272000

272000 is GPT-5.6-Luna's context (GPT 5.6 Luna (≤ 272K tokens), see also the Go usage table). It looks like the Codex OpenAI template's default window is used as the fallback when a max_context_window is being computed, instead of the model's own limit.context that magpie already has (and correctly writes to max_context_window).

Impact

  • The agent's own context accounting (compaction thresholds, "context left" indicators, /context) is computed from context_window. A 1M model is treated as 272K: Codex compacts far earlier than it needs to, and the difference is invisible in the UI.

  • Users cannot fix it from magpie: magpie codex has no context field (model, effort, subagent, subagent_model, subagent_effort, memories, login), and there is no per-model context override in the provider editor.

  • Workaround users reach for is editing magpie-desktop-models.json, which magpie regenerates.

Suggested fix

When building the Codex catalog entry, take context_window from the model's real context (the same value already written to max_context_window / the vendor's /v1/models context_length), not from the OpenAI template default. max_context_window can stay as the ceiling; context_window should be the effective window.

Optionally: an explicit per-model context override in the provider editor would let users pin a value when a vendor reports one that is too conservative (and would let magpie- regen not fight such a pin).

Reproduction

  1. Add an OpenCode Go provider (opencode.ai/zen/go/v1) with a key.

  2. Set Codex's model to opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash.

  3. Open ~/.codex/magpie-desktop-models.json and read that entry: context_window = 272000 while max_context_window = 1000000.

  4. Codex shows ~272K for a 1M model.

Notes

  • Filed from a real setup; no crafted case. Verified by reading magpie's own /v1/models, models.dev, and the generated catalog on the same machine.

  • The same 272000 appears for the native gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-reserve, codex-auto-review rows too — with max_context_window 872000. If the template value is intentional for those, then the issue is only that it is also applied to routed (non-OpenAI) models that have a different real context.

issue.title: [Bug] Codex /models：x-api-key 覆盖有效 OAuth 为 Bearer magpie，导致 401 和上下文回退

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 问题与影响

Codex 保留 ChatGPT 登录、同时使用 Magpie 的 managed gateway key 时，GET `/backend-api/codex/models` 会返回 401。已用同一份有效 OAuth 做请求对照：只去掉 `x-api-key`，同一路径立即返回 200 和正确的模型窗口。

源码确认：`identifyCaller` 验证 gateway key 后，把原本有效的 `Authorization` 覆盖为内部标记 `Bearer magpie`；模型目录路径随后把这个标记转发给 ChatGPT，没有重新签名。

这会让 Codex 无法刷新 Magpie 声明的模型元数据。本机 Astra 会话的有效窗口实际从 828400 回退到 258400，自动压缩阈值从 784800 降到 244800，长会话随后反复压缩。模型和推理档位仍为 Astra / Ultra。

## 环境与配置

- Magpie **v0.1.2909**，macOS arm64。
- Codex 桌面端内置 CLI **0.166.0-alpha.6**。
- 核查时间：2026-11-04。
- Magpie 的 Codex provider 对 `gpt-6-astra` 显式设置 `contexts = 872000`。
- Codex 没有显式设置 `model_context_window` 或 `model_auto_compact_token_limit`。
- 当前接入配置如下；不主张这段配置一定由 Magpie 自动生成：

```toml
model = "gpt-6-astra"
model_provider = "custom"
model_reasoning_effort = "ultra"

[model_providers.custom]
name = "OpenAI"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:3425/backend-api/codex"
wire_api = "responses"
requires_openai_auth = true
supports_websockets = false

[model_providers.custom.http_headers]
x-api-key = "<valid Magpie managed gateway key>"
```

该 custom provider 没有 `experimental_bearer_token`，也没有额外配置 `Authorization`；OAuth 来自 Codex 已有登录。

## 最小复现：仅查询模型目录

对同一个本机网关发送：

```http
GET /backend-api/codex/models?client_version=0.166.0
Authorization: Bearer <valid Codex OAuth access token>
ChatGPT-Account-ID: <matching account>
x-api-key: <valid Magpie managed gateway key>
Accept: application/json
```

在同一次验证中，仅改变认证头组合：

| 请求头 | 实际结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 有效 OAuth + 对应 account header + 有效 x-api-key | **401** |
| 同一份 OAuth + 同一个 account header，去掉 x-api-key | **200**；Astra 的 context_window 和 max_context_window 均为 **872000** |
| 只有有效 x-api-key | **401**，错误相同 |

401 正文：

```json
{"detail":"Could not parse your authentication token. Please try signing in again."}
```

第二组仍然经过 Magpie，并非绕开网关直连。它说明这一失败不需要 OAuth 失效或重新登录才能触发。验证只发送 GET 模型目录请求，没有为此发送推理请求。

## 源码原因

以下链接固定到安装版本 v0.1.2909：

1. [loopback 请求带 managed key 时进入 identifyCaller](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.2909/internal/gateway/lan.go#L493-L503)；[callerKeys / managedKey 包含 x-api-key](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.2909/internal/gateway/lan.go#L740-L774)。
2. [identifyCaller 无条件覆盖 Authorization](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.2909/internal/gateway/lan.go#L672-L680)：

   ```go
   r.Header = r.Header.Clone()
   r.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+Token)
   ```

   [Token 是公开常量 "magpie"](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.2909/internal/gateway/gateway.go#L54)，不是用户的 OAuth。
3. [GET /models 进入 codexModels](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.2909/internal/gateway/codex_backend.go#L90-L93)。[askCodexList 复制认证头后直接发送](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.2909/internal/gateway/codex_backend.go#L2191-L2206)，[copyHeaders 保留 Authorization](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.2909/internal/gateway/codex_backend.go#L2073-L2078)。
4. [普通 401 原样返回，提前退出](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.2909/internal/gateway/codex_backend.go#L2225-L2251)，因此后续 [CodexNativeWindow / 窗口覆盖](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/v0.1.2909/internal/gateway/codex_backend.go#L2279-L2294) 没有执行。

核查时 main 为 `3eb2bda4f2e3ba8aa0eb2c7870d9c746798687a1`；上述 `lan.go` 和 `codex_backend.go` 与 v0.1.2909 完整文件内容一致。运行复现基于安装版，main 只做了源码对照。

## 上下文回退的现场证据

同一个 Astra / Ultra 长会话在当天 15:23 前后出现以下运行时值变化（UTC+8，摘录必要字段）：

```text
full_context_window_limit: 828400 -> 258400
auto_compact_scope_limit: 784800 -> 244800
```

Codex 当前安装程序的内置 Astra 目录是 `context_window=272000, max_context_window=872000`；258400 正好是 `272000 × 95%`。正常拿到 Magpie 的 872000 覆盖时，有效窗口为 828400。

同机还出现过缓存过期和 provider/auth identity mismatch，但不是每条都来自受影响会话的进程；不把它们当成这次认证覆盖的必要触发条件，也没有把每次历史窗口跳变都归因于同一原因。

## 期望

同时携带有效 gateway key 和 ChatGPT OAuth 时，gateway key 用于本地身份/权限校验，Codex 原生目录请求应保留或正确恢复其上游 OAuth 身份，不能把内部 `Bearer magpie` 发给 ChatGPT。

建议增加回归用例：在 mock ChatGPT 上游断言“有效 OAuth + managed x-api-key”的模型目录请求仍使用正确 OAuth，且返回列表应用用户的窗口覆盖；同时保留 gateway key 的权限和失效检查。

相关：#1955 是模型目录超时后的旧窗口回退；#4308 是登录确已被撤销。本例的区别是 OAuth 本身有效，加上 managed x-api-key 才触发 401。


另见 #2145：该报告针对 WSL NAT 的远程接入，维护者通过调整接入方式修复且报告者已确认。本例发生在本机回环地址，并用有效 OAuth 与 managed key 的双凭据对照定位到了头部覆盖。
